preconditions.description: The target sum S must be a positive integer within the range [1, 10^6].

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.val >= 1 and root.val <= 10**6)
preconditions.description: If the root exists, its value must be a positive integer within the range [1, 10^6].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [root] if root) or not root
preconditions.description: All node values in the tree must be positive integers within the range [1, 10^6].

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(path, list) and all(isinstance(val, int) for val in path) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path in the result is a list of integers representing node values.
Each path must contain at least one node (root).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == S for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: The sum of node values in each path must equal the target sum S.

postconditions.expression: all(path[0] == root.val if root else True for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every path must start with the root node's value if the tree is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: not any(path[-1] == leaf.val and leaf.left is None and leaf.right is None for path in return_value for leaf in [node for node in [root] if root] if node) or not root
postconditions.description: No path in the result may end on a leaf node.
